acceptance: Reproduce on current develop with DuckDB: `benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark tpch --scale 0.01 --phases generate,load` (or the equivalent flags) and record the traceback.
A load-only run that loads successfully exits 0 and prints a load summary without power-test fields.
A load-only run whose load fails still exits non-zero.
Regression tests cover load-only output and exit codes for SQL and DataFrame paths, and tuned load-only runs.
context: Reported in ~/.benchbox/handoffs/2026-10-15-snowflake-trial-exit-handoff.md (campaign C0 notes). Likely areas: benchbox/cli/output.py (_render_overall_status, ~line 378-480) and the run result summary in benchbox/cli/commands/run.py.
description: A run with `--phases generate,load` and no power phase loads the data and then exits 1 with "'NoneType' object has no attribute 'overall_status'". The result output path appears to assume power-test results exist. Load-only runs are a documented mode and tuned load-only parity depends on them, so a successful load reports failure to scripts and CI. Found on develop during the 2026-10-15 Snowflake campaign; not yet reproduced locally.
